lesson: Flow reversal (Coval & Stafford 2007 fire sales, Lou 2012 flow-driven returns) applied as S5 mutation with VT15%+DD5/15 overlay destroys the already marginal alpha of foreign-flow contrarian signal in Korean market. Turnover 3205% (5x hard cap) is the root cause — monthly rebalancing of a noisy 20-day rolling flow signal generates excessive churn. The aggressive VT+DD overlays then crush residual returns to CAGR 1.86% (vs BM 11.13%). Key lesson: flow-based signals require turnover management (quarterly rebal, magnitude threshold, or wider buffer zones) BEFORE layering volatility/drawdown overlays. Overlays cannot rescue a signal that is already bleeding to transaction costs.
